constraints.constraint: Strategies must extend ValidatedStrategy base classes
Use @log_signal() decorator on z-score computation methods
Log schema must include: mean, std_dev, z_score, signal in data field
Must return z_score=0 when std_dev=0 (avoid division by zero)
Must return neutral signal when insufficient lookback data

tests.standards: Use pytest with @pytest.mark.layer_2_signals marker. Follow Zero Mock Enforcement. Test edge cases for division by zero and insufficient data. Use Decimal for precision-sensitive tests.
